title: Mixing: We’re Open Tonight, Cage, He Didn’t Mean It, Rockestra Theme, After The Ball, Million Miles, Love Awake by Wings | 1978
content:
Lympne Castle, Lympne
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

Wings’ final recording session at Lympne Castle for the Back To The Egg album took place on 29 September 1978.

The band had recording a number of songs for the album from 11-29 September, although precise details are not known. They recorded at Lympne Castle in Lympne (pronounced ‘Lim’) in Kent, England using the RAK Mobile Recording Unit.

On this day mixes of the best recordings were made: ‘We’re Open Tonight’, an unreleased medley of two songs, ‘Cage’ and ‘He Didn’t Mean It’, a Wings demo of ‘Rockestra Theme’, ‘After The Ball’, ‘Million Miles’, and ‘Love Awake’.

Paul McCartney also took away a tape reel containing a number of jams, one of which was a ‘Rockestra Theme’ reggae version. The reel also contained a piece titled ‘End Of Sessions Party (September 29)’, indicating that celebrations were held on this date to mark the end of the Lympne recordings.
